name: Accumulator
description: Adds the Accumulator character: every N kills permanently improves a random primary or secondary stat in the player's favor.

kills_per_bonus.title: Kills Per Bonus
kills_per_bonus.description: Number of kills required to trigger +1 random stat.

bonus_amount.title: Bonus Amount
bonus_amount.description: How much the chosen stat changes each time (always in the player's favor).

show_popup.title: Show Popup
show_popup.description: Display a floating text popup when a stat bonus is triggered.

enable_drawback.title: Enable Drawback
enable_drawback.description: Start the run with -10% Damage as a drawback.
